column1: # Which code block of a doc equals which tagged regions of the Shop (`#region snippet: <name>` under samples/ or
# tests/Resultful.EndToEnd/Broken/). block: `<heading prefix>#<n>`, the n-th fenced block under the first heading
# that starts with the prefix, or `tag:<name>` for a block preceded by `<!-- snippet: <name> -->`. regions: names
# joined with `+`, compared in order. Blank lines and indentation are ignored; everything else must be equal.
